question: In a certain code language, DANGER is written as EDSHHW. How will SPEEDY be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

DANGER is written as EDSHHW.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e58ddd0fbf18b776de3fcffec5aed7c7bc01d3b1517cd9a3aa520b337d106e72.png] 

Similarly,

SPEEDY will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a836d6e1d4f7aaceada3fd58611f6963b9f5c89a8df8593784f292fc383a3c67.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"TSJFGD".**
